comment: Example extraction from Public Service Co of Colorado - Primary General Service (Schedule PG)

document_applicability.extraction_approach: Extracted Schedule PG (Primary General Service) including all demand charges, energy charges, fixed charges, and applicable riders; No exclusions (single-utility electric tariff)

rates.applicability: All customers taking primary voltage service
rates.details: Fixed Charge (First Meter): $912.71/month. Rate includes EEAC (Energy Efficiency Adjustment Clause) in fixed charge component.
rates.conditions: Applicable to electric power service supplied at primary voltage. Not applicable to standby or resale service.
rates.related_charges: Subject to all applicable Electric Rate Adjustments as on file and in effect in this tariff
rates.exclusions: Not applicable to standby or resale service

rates.details: Seasonal/Monthly Demand Charge: $5.72 per kW for all months (Jan-Dec). Applied to monthly billing demand.
rates.tariff_section: Schedule PG - Seasonal/Monthly Demand Charge Structure
rates.calculation_method: Rate = Customer Charge + Purchased Capacity Costs Adjustment + Demand Side Management Cost Adjustment + Transmission Cost Adjustment + Transportation Electrification Program + Renewable Energy Standard Adjustment RESA and CEPA Colorado Energy Plan
rates.related_charges: Plus applicable adjustments: PCCA, DSMCA, TCA, TEP, RESA, CEPA
rates.exclusions: Not applicable to standby or resale service

rates.details: Time of Use Demand Charge Structure - Period 1 (Off-peak): $0.00 per kW. Applies to all hours outside of periods 2 and 3. See weekday/weekend hourly schedule matrices for detailed hour-by-hour period assignments.
rates.tariff_section: Schedule PG - Time of Use Demand Charge Structure, Period 1
rates.tou_period_definition: Period 1 applies to all hours except 2-6 PM. See tariff weekday/weekend schedule matrices showing hourly period assignments for each month.
rates.related_charges: Part of TOU demand structure with Periods 1, 2, and 3
rates.exclusions: Not applicable to standby or resale service

rates.applicability: Mid-peak hours demand during winter months
rates.details: Time of Use Demand Charge Structure - Period 2 (Mid-peak): $15.75 per kW. Applies during 2-6 PM hours on both weekdays and weekends for October through May. See weekday/weekend hourly schedule matrices for detailed hour-by-hour period assignments.
rates.tariff_section: Schedule PG - Time of Use Demand Charge Structure, Period 2
rates.tou_period_definition: Period 2 (Mid-peak) applies 2-6 PM on weekdays and weekends during Oct-May. Hour 14-18 in schedule matrices show value '2' for these months.
rates.related_charges: Part of TOU demand structure with Periods 1, 2, and 3
rates.exclusions: Not applicable to standby or resale service

rates.applicability: Peak hours demand during summer months
rates.details: Time of Use Demand Charge Structure - Period 3 (Peak): $21.18 per kW. Applies during 2-6 PM hours on both weekdays and weekends for June through September. See weekday/weekend hourly schedule matrices for detailed hour-by-hour period assignments.
rates.tariff_section: Schedule PG - Time of Use Demand Charge Structure, Period 3
rates.tou_period_definition: Period 3 (Peak) applies 2-6 PM on weekdays and weekends during Jun-Sep. Hour 14-18 in schedule matrices show value '3' for these months.
rates.related_charges: Part of TOU demand structure with Periods 1, 2, and 3
rates.exclusions: Not applicable to standby or resale service

rates.applicability: All kWh usage during summer months
rates.details: Tiered Energy Usage Charge - Period 1 (Summer): $0.04044 per kWh. Applies to all kWh consumption during June through September. See weekday/weekend energy schedule matrices showing tier '1' for all hours Jun-Sep.
rates.tariff_section: Schedule PG - Tiered Energy Usage Charge Structure, Period 1
rates.calculation_method: Rate = Customer Charge + Electric Commodity adjustment + Renewable Energy Standard adjustment. EEAC included in Fixed Charge.
rates.related_charges: Plus Electric Commodity Adjustment and Renewable Energy Standard Adjustment
rates.exclusions: Not applicable to standby or resale service

rates.applicability: All kWh usage during winter months
rates.details: Tiered Energy Usage Charge - Period 2 (Winter): $0.03378 per kWh. Applies to all kWh consumption during October through May. See weekday/weekend energy schedule matrices showing tier '2' for all hours Oct-May.
rates.tariff_section: Schedule PG - Tiered Energy Usage Charge Structure, Period 2
rates.calculation_method: Rate = Customer Charge + Electric Commodity adjustment + Renewable Energy Standard adjustment. EEAC included in Fixed Charge.
rates.related_charges: Plus Electric Commodity Adjustment and Renewable Energy Standard Adjustment
rates.exclusions: Not applicable to standby or resale service

note: Additional riders mentioned that would be extracted as separate entries if detailed in tariff: Purchased Capacity Costs Adjustment, Demand Side Management Cost Adjustment, Transmission Cost Adjustment, Transportation Electrification Program, RESA (Renewable Energy Standard Adjustment), CEPA (Colorado Energy Plan Adjustment), Electric Commodity Adjustment, Energy Efficiency Adjustment Clause (EEAC)
